A0.definition: Produces a plan or recommendation; a human performs all consequential work.
A0.name: Advisory

A1.definition: Executes one bounded tool action and returns a verified artifact.
A1.name: Single-step execution

A2.definition: Executes a prescribed multi-step workflow with deterministic checks.
A2.name: Workflow execution

A3.definition: Diagnoses failures, repairs or replans within a budget, and resumes from checkpoints.
A3.name: Adaptive recovery

A4.definition: Chooses methods and next computations or experiments under scientific and resource constraints.
A4.name: Research campaign

A5.definition: Coordinates digital reasoning with physical instruments or robots and updates decisions from observations.
A5.name: Embodied closed loop

E2E_ASR.definition: Campaign-level success under a fixed tool, time, compute and intervention budget.
E2E_ASR.name: End-to-End Autonomous Success Rate

HIR.definition: Number and severity of human interventions per verified work unit; reported, not concealed.
HIR.name: Human Intervention Rate

RNU.definition: Verified scientific utility normalized by wall time, compute, monetary cost and consumed experimental budget.
RNU.name: Resource-Normalized Utility

RRR.definition: Probability of reaching a valid terminal state after injected tool, environment or hardware faults.
RRR.name: Recovery and Resume Reliability

SSR.definition: Fraction of executions that remain within declared physical, instrument, data-governance and laboratory safety constraints throughout the trajectory.
SSR.name: Scientific Safety Rate

VSS.definition: Fraction of runs whose final result passes all mandatory scientific and execution gates.
VSS.name: Verified Scientific Success

WRC.definition: Criticality-weighted fraction of human workflow steps completed by the agent without hidden human correction and accepted by an independent verifier.
WRC.name: Work Replacement Coverage

horizons.CAMPAIGN: A goal-directed research campaign spanning methods, decisions and resource budgets.
horizons.CLOSED_LOOP: Adaptive design-build-test-learn or simulation-experiment cycles with knowledge updates.
horizons.UNIT: One bounded scientific action with a local verifier.
horizons.WORKFLOW: A multi-step, multi-tool workflow with intermediate state and recovery.

mission: Measure verified replacement of professional materials-research work from evidence to computation, multiscale integration, experiments, robotics and closed-loop campaigns.
principles: Goal to execution to independent verification.
Artifacts and trajectories, not conversational plausibility.
Human intervention is logged and reduces autonomy credit.
Replay, live compute, digital twin and physical lab are distinct.
Fatal scientific or safety failures cannot be averaged away.
Materials is the first domain adapter of a cross-industry protocol.

suites.objective: Retrieve, extract, bind and synthesize scientific evidence without losing source, material-state or condition identity.
suites.title: Evidence, literature and scientific memory

suites.objective: Deploy research artifacts, manage environments, dispatch jobs, checkpoint, resume, recover and preserve execution provenance.
suites.title: Research software, environments and compute operations

suites.objective: Construct, execute and verify CALPHAD, Scheil, diffusion, precipitation and phase-stability workflows.
suites.title: Thermodynamics, phase stability and kinetics

suites.objective: Build physically correct atomistic structures, run or replay DFT, verify convergence and extract defect, interface and deformation energetics.
suites.title: Electronic structure and atomistic defects

suites.objective: Curate training data, train or select a potential, pass physical gates and conduct finite-temperature simulations without extrapolating silently.
suites.title: Machine-learned potentials and molecular dynamics

examples: phase-field replay against known microstructure evolution
suites.objective: Configure, execute and validate phase-field, cellular-automata and mesoscale kinetics models with explicit physical assumptions.
suites.title: Mesoscale microstructure evolution

suites.objective: Build and calibrate continuum models, enforce mechanical boundary conditions and validate local fields against experiments.
suites.title: Continuum mechanics, CPFEM, RVE and FEM

suites.objective: Transfer quantities and uncertainty across thermodynamic, electronic, atomistic, mesoscale and continuum models without invalid scale jumps.
suites.title: Cross-scale integration and consistency

suites.objective: Plan high-value experiments, preserve specimen and measurement identity, and convert instrument outputs into verified observations.
suites.title: Experiment planning, execution records and characterization

suites.objective: Compile protocols into safe executable actions, operate or simulate instruments and recover from trajectory-level faults.
suites.title: Laboratory robotics and embodied scientific agents

suites.objective: Pursue a scientific goal through evidence, computation, modeling, experiment selection, result intake and knowledge update under a fixed budget.
suites.title: End-to-end autonomous materials research campaigns

suites.objective: Produce publication and decision artifacts whose claims remain bound to source data, computations, limitations and negative results.
suites.title: Figures, manuscripts, peer review and decision communication
